triggers.name: Magi feedback transfix
patterns: ^With blinding speed, you weave fire and air together in a hypnotic pattern that transfixes (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback magma
patterns: ^You weave fire and earth and bubbling magma boils into existence to wash over (\S+) in a skin-melting tide\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback dehydrate_attempt
patterns: ^Weaving the elements of fire and water, you attempt to rip the excess water from the body of (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback dehydrate_dry
patterns: ^The skin of (\S+) begins to dry and crack as \S+ grows pale\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback dehydrate_burning
patterns: ^You fan the heat of (\S+)'s body into consuming flame\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback dehydrate_freeze
patterns: ^You rip the heat from (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback bombard
patterns: ^You tap the Elemental Plane of Earth, summoning up a flurry of rocks to bombard (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback fulminate
patterns: ^You click your fingers and lightning strikes from the air to smite (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback mudslide
patterns: ^You weave earth and water and a torrent of thick mud thunders forth to roll over (\S+), knocking \S+ sprawling\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback asthma
patterns: ^(\S+) clutches at \S+ throat as \S+ gasps for breath\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback sensitivity
patterns: ^A vicious wind rises, lashing and flaying at the body of (\S+) to leave \S+ sensitive and raw\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback healthleech
patterns: ^A dreadful pallor overcomes the features of (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback frostbite
patterns: ^As you begin to tap your connection with the Elemental Plane of Water, you summon up a freezing wave to deluge (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback stuttering
patterns: ^You summon up a flurry of icicles to slash at (\S+) in a shower of freezing daggers\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback anorexia
patterns: ^The might of Elemental Water suffusing you, you tear at the vital fluids which sustain the body of (\S+) with your will alone\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback limb_break
patterns: ^A loud crack emanates from the (.+) of (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback paralysis
patterns: ^You bleed off residual power from your connection with the Elemental Plane of Earth, directing it in an unfocussed blast of arcane might at (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback fire_moderate
patterns: ^You will that (\S+) should burn, and so \S+ does\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback blisters
patterns: ^The incandescent might of Elemental Fire filling you, you command (\S+) to burn from within\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback fire_major_burning
patterns: ^The incandescent might of Elemental Fire filling you, you command the suffering (\S+) to burn from within\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback emanation_air
patterns: ^You sweep .+ over your head and a great wind rises, picking up (\S+) and dashing them violently about before casting them back to the ground\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback emanation_earth
patterns: ^The might of elemental Earth thrumming within your bones, you point .+ at (\S+) and an intangible wave of power strikes forth to smite \S+\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback emanation_water
patterns: ^The might of elemental Water surging through your body, you make the slightest flick with .+, and the hand of Sllshya descends as a freezing deluge to smash (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback emanation_fire
patterns: ^The might of elemental Fire filling you like a scorching river, you lift .+ to point at (\S+) and unleash a stream of searing flame\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback hypothermia
patterns: ^You blast (\S+) with an icy stream of water, and \S+ begins to shiver uncontrollably\.$
^\S+ blasts (\S+) with an icy stream of water, and \S+ begins to shake and shiver uncontrollably\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback conflagrate
patterns: ^You bend your will upon (\S+), and command that \S+ burn\.$
^\S+ lifts a hand towards (\S+) and in an instant raging flames manifest to devour \S+ victim\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback conflagrate_fail
patterns: ^You bend your will upon (\S+), attempting to rouse a conflagration to consume \S+, but to no avail\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback freeze
patterns: ^You raise a hand towards (\S+) and blast \S+ with cold, frigid air\.$

patterns: ^You drain the heat from the air around your enemies, causing them to experience the cold of the abyss itself\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback immolation
patterns: ^You sense a combustive spark take hold of (\S+)\.$

triggers.name: Magi feedback scintilla_burning
patterns: ^Flames ignite all over the body of (\S+), fanned to intensity in an instant\.$
